title: Best Accounting Software for Small Business 2026: QuickBooks vs FreshBooks vs Zoho Books

claims.claim_text: Automated transaction categorization correctly classifies roughly 95% of expenses without manual intervention
claims.finding: Intuit's official documentation states QuickBooks Online can auto-categorize expenses with a 'high rate of accuracy' but does not specify a 95% accuracy figure. Third-party sources cite 85-95% or 50% accuracy depending on context, but no official Intuit pages confirm the specific 95% claim.
QuickBooks Online Plus provides 60+ standard report templates according to official Intuit documentation, which aligns with the claim of over 60 customizable report templates.

claims.claim_text: Has over 750 connected apps in its third-party integration ecosystem
claims.finding: QuickBooks Online's official integration page states they integrate with over 750 popular business apps, and their accountant ecosystem page also confirms 750+ integrated apps available.

QuickBooks Online Simple Start currently costs $38 per month, not $35. The price increased from $35 to $38 as part of Intuit's pricing changes that took effect in mid-2025 and apply to 2026 subscriptions.
The current official price for QuickBooks Online Essentials is $85 per month as of August 2026, not $65 per month. The price increased from $75/month to $85/month effective August 1, 2026.

The Plus tier now costs $140/month as of August 2026, according to multiple current sources including vendor-related pricing information. The claim of $99/month was the previous price before the August 2026 price increase.
According to current official pricing information, QuickBooks Online Advanced costs $275 per month, not $235 per month as claimed.

claims.claim_text: Plus tier includes up to five users
claims.finding: QuickBooks Online Plus includes up to 5 users according to official Intuit documentation, which matches the claim exactly.

claims.claim_text: Payroll services cost an additional $45/month plus $5 per employee
claims.finding: Current QuickBooks Workforce Payroll pricing is $50/month plus $6.50 per employee as of July 2026, not $45/month plus $5 per employee as claimed. The product was also rebranded from QuickBooks Online Payroll to QuickBooks Workforce.
